verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly mention interactive widgets to explore/test the Core API directly from the browser and a sandbox environment for hands-on experimentation, plus a quick-start tutorial for simulating transactions — supporting the interactive/runnable-examples story. However, probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and there's no independent corroboration of the interactive widgets' functionality. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the interactive widgets, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and AI-native discovery files (llms.txt/docs.md).
